# Owner Identity Derivation — Version-1 Implementation

This is a **Spring PetClinic REST** app (Maven; request handling via OfficeFloor function injection). The `OwnerDto`/`OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto.OwnerSegmentEnum` DTO classes are **generated at build time** from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` by the openapi-generator-maven-plugin (spring generator, `modelPackage org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`) — they do not exist as source files.

Important framing: the current codebase is **v1**. The OpenAPI header declares `version: '1.0'`, the DTO exposes `memberId`/`identityKey`/`householdId` **at the top level**, and there is **no `apiVersion` field and no nested `identity` object** anywhere in the production code. The only `apiVersion`/nested-identity reference is a currently-failing/target acceptance test (`AcceptanceTest.java`) describing the intended v2 shape. There is **no `schemaVersion`** anywhere in the repo.

---

## 1. Region-code derivation and mixing into identifiers

The region code is derived from postcode and mixed into `memberId`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMemberId.java`** — builds `memberId` = `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`. `REGION_RANGE` maps NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else `UNKNOWN`; `regionOf(postcode)` picks the region; concatenated with FY (from `FiscalYear`), an 8-char SHA-256 hash of `telephone+lastName`, and a Luhn check digit; then de-duplicated by appending `-<n>`. (Full source read; key derivation lines 43-78.)

The region is also read back **out** of the assigned `memberId` for DTO fields:

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/Locality.java`** — `Locality.of(memberId)` returns the leading region prefix (NSW/VIC/QLD) or `UNKNOWN`. `REGIONS = List.of("NSW","VIC","QLD")`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/MemberId.java`** — `MemberId.fiscalYear(memberId)` reads the two FY digits after the region prefix, returns `FY<YY>`.

---

## 2. Code producing `householdId`, `identityKey`, `memberId`

- **`memberId`**: produced by `AssignMemberId.java` (above); stored via `Owner.setMemberId`.
- **`householdId`**: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHousehold.java`** — `deriveHouseholdId` = first 12 hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode)`, lower-case. Keyed on `(lastName, postcode)`.
- **`identityKey`**: computed as a **derived getter** on the model — **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** `getIdentityKey()` (lines 292-297): lower-case 64-char `SHA-256(telephone + "|" + email + "|" + Soundex(lastName))`. Uniqueness enforced by **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java`** (409 via `OwnerIdentityConflictException` on whole-key match; `sharesHousehold` bypasses).

Supporting model helpers:
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Soundex.java`** — American Soundex used by `identityKey`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/FiscalYear.java`** — FY arithmetic (starts 1 July) for the `FY` segment of `memberId`.

`Owner.java` fields: `memberId` (col `member_id`), `householdId` (col `household_id`), and `getPrimaryIdentifier()` (lines 201-203) which **returns `memberId`** — the single accessor audit events route through.

---

## 3. Owner response DTO/shape (locality, timezone, ownerSegment / derived region)

The DTO is generated from **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** (schema `Owner`, lines 2124-2383). Derived fields are populated by the MapStruct mapper:

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — `toOwnerDto` maps, among others: `locality = Locality.of(owner.getMemberId())`, `timezone = Timezone.of(Locality.of(owner.getMemberId()))`, `ownerSegment = OwnerSegment.of(owner)`, `fiscalYear = MemberId.fiscalYear(...)`, plus `membershipLevel/Points`, `riskFlag`, `ageBand`, `contactPreference`, `telephoneDisplay`, `displayName`, `salutation`, `initials`, `selfLink`.

Derived-field helpers (all package-private in `mapper/`):
- **`Locality.java`** (region) and **`Timezone.java`** (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/Timezone.java`) — `REGION_TIMEZONE`: NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane; else `null`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerSegment.java`** — segment `<TIER>_<AREA>`: TIER=`PREMIUM` if `MembershipLevel.of(owner) >= 3` else `STANDARD`; AREA=`METRO` if `Locality.of(memberId)` ∈ {NSW,VIC,QLD} else `REGIONAL`. Returns `OwnerDto.OwnerSegmentEnum`.
- Also present (derived DTO fields, not central to identity): `mapper/AgeBand.java`, `RiskFlag.java`, `ContactPreference.java`, `TelephoneDisplay.java`, `DisposableAdjacent.java`; `model/MembershipLevel.java`, `MembershipLevel` cap in `Owner`.

OpenAPI schema field descriptions (load-bearing, from `openapi.yml`):
- `memberId` (2181-2194): `'<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'`, region from postcode.
- `householdId` (2206-2216): first 12 hex of SHA-256 over lastName|postcode.
- `identityKey` (2217-2229): 64-char SHA-256 over telephone|email|Soundex(lastName).
- `locality` (2265-2272): leading REGION of memberId; `UNKNOWN` fallback.
- `timezone` (2273-2282): IANA tz from region table; null for UNKNOWN.
- `ownerSegment` (2347-2360): enum `PREMIUM_METRO|PREMIUM_REGIONAL|STANDARD_METRO|STANDARD_REGIONAL`.

There is **no `apiVersion` and no `identity` wrapper** in this schema — everything is flat/top-level (v1).

---

## 4. Audit event schema/code

There is **no `schemaVersion`**. The audit event is emitted on owner create:

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — logs to a dedicated `AUDIT` logger: a formatted line (`id`, `memberId`, `registrationDate`, `membershipLevel`) plus a JSON `OwnerCreatedEvent`. **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`** — immutable `record OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, int ownerId, String memberId, int membershipLevel)`; `toJson()` renders `{"seq":…,"ownerId":…,"memberId":…,"membershipLevel":…,"event":"OWNER_CREATED"}`. Discriminator constant `EVENT = "OWNER_CREATED"`. **No `schemaVersion` field on the event.**

Test-side capture: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`** — attaches a Logback `ListAppender` to the `AUDIT` logger; `anyContains`, `anyAtLevel`, `count`, `messages`.

---

## 5. Existing `apiVersion` reference

- **Production code: none.** No `apiVersion` field on the DTO or anywhere in `src/main`.
- OpenAPI declares document `version: '1.0'` (`openapi.yml` line 8) — not a response `apiVersion`.
- The only `apiVersion` occurrence is in the target/acceptance test (see #6).
- There are `owner-v2`/`pets-v2` tags and OfficeFloor v2 route stubs under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/v2/owners.GET.yml` and `.../v2/pets.GET.yml`, plus openapi lines 15-23 describing "Version 2 endpoints". The many `openapi.yml` "An ID for this version of the response" hits refer to a per-response header `responseId`, not `apiVersion`.

---

## 6. Tests referencing these things

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`** — the v2 target contract (currently the only concrete `apiVersion` reference). Asserts on `GET /api/owners/{id}`:
```
$.apiVersion == 2
$.identity.memberId isNotEmpty
$.identity.identityKey isNotEmpty
$.identity.householdId isNotEmpty
$.memberId / $.identityKey / $.householdId  doesNotExist   (no longer top-level)
```
Header comment: "identity-v2: apiVersion is 2, the memberId/identityKey/householdId are grouped under a nested 'identity' object". This shape is **not yet implemented** in v1.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`** — black-box base. Pinned reference tables directly relevant: `CITY_REGION` (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), `REGION_TIMEZONE`, `REGION_POSTCODES` (same ranges as `AssignMemberId`), `region()`, `timezone()`, `validPostcode()`, `knownOwner()`; replicated `sha256hex`, `shaHex`, `luhn`, `toBusinessDay`. `structuredOwner()` (postcode 2000/NSW) is used by the v2 test.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`** — audit capture helper (above).

These three are the entire test tree (`src/test/java/.../acceptance/`).

---

## How tests are run

- **Build tool: Maven** (wrapper `./mvnw`; `pom.xml`; parent `spring-boot-starter-parent`). No Gradle.
- Test frameworks: JUnit 5 (`spring-boot-starter-test`) + MockMvc (`spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test`).
- Generated sources (incl. `OwnerDto`) are produced during build by the **openapi-generator-maven-plugin** (`pom.xml` lines 369-388) from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi` — so a clean build/generation must run before tests compile.
- Commands (from `readme.md`): `mvn clean install` (build incl. generation), `./mvnw spring-boot:run` to run the app. Standard test invocation: `./mvnw test` (unit) / `./mvnw verify`. To run just the acceptance test: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMemberId.java`** — builds `memberId` = `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`. `REGION_RANGE` maps NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else `UNKNOWN`; `regionOf(postcode)` picks the region; concatenated with FY (from `FiscalYear`), an 8-char SHA-256 hash of `telephone+lastName`, and a Luhn check digit; then de-duplicated by appending `-<n>`. (Full source read; key derivation lines 43-78.)

The region is also read back **out** of the assigned `memberId` for DTO fields:

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/Locality.java`** — `Locality.of(memberId)` returns the leading region prefix (NSW/VIC/QLD) or `UNKNOWN`. `REGIONS = List.of("NSW","VIC","QLD")`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/MemberId.java`** — `MemberId.fiscalYear(memberId)` reads the two FY digits after the region prefix, returns `FY<YY>`.

---

## 2. Code producing `householdId`, `identityKey`, `memberId`

- **`memberId`**: produced by `AssignMemberId.java` (above); stored via `Owner.setMemberId`.
- **`householdId`**: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHousehold.java`** — `deriveHouseholdId` = first 12 hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode)`, lower-case. Keyed on `(lastName, postcode)`.
- **`identityKey`**: computed as a **derived getter** on the model — **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** `getIdentityKey()` (lines 292-297): lower-case 64-char `SHA-256(telephone + "|" + email + "|" + Soundex(lastName))`. Uniqueness enforced by **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java`** (409 via `OwnerIdentityConflictException` on whole-key match; `sharesHousehold` bypasses).

Supporting model helpers:
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Soundex.java`** — American Soundex used by `identityKey`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/FiscalYear.java`** — FY arithmetic (starts 1 July) for the `FY` segment of `memberId`.

`Owner.java` fields: `memberId` (col `member_id`), `householdId` (col `household_id`), and `getPrimaryIdentifier()` (lines 201-203) which **returns `memberId`** — the single accessor audit events route through.

---

## 3. Owner response DTO/shape (locality, timezone, ownerSegment / derived region)

The DTO is generated from **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** (schema `Owner`, lines 2124-2383). Derived fields are populated by the MapStruct mapper:

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — `toOwnerDto` maps, among others: `locality = Locality.of(owner.getMemberId())`, `timezone = Timezone.of(Locality.of(owner.getMemberId()))`, `ownerSegment = OwnerSegment.of(owner)`, `fiscalYear = MemberId.fiscalYear(...)`, plus `membershipLevel/Points`, `riskFlag`, `ageBand`, `contactPreference`, `telephoneDisplay`, `displayName`, `salutation`, `initials`, `selfLink`.

Derived-field helpers (all package-private in `mapper/`):
- **`Locality.java`** (region) and **`Timezone.java`** (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/Timezone.java`) — `REGION_TIMEZONE`: NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane; else `null`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerSegment.java`** — segment `<TIER>_<AREA>`: TIER=`PREMIUM` if `MembershipLevel.of(owner) >= 3` else `STANDARD`; AREA=`METRO` if `Locality.of(memberId)` ∈ {NSW,VIC,QLD} else `REGIONAL`. Returns `OwnerDto.OwnerSegmentEnum`.
- Also present (derived DTO fields, not central to identity): `mapper/AgeBand.java`, `RiskFlag.java`, `ContactPreference.java`, `TelephoneDisplay.java`, `DisposableAdjacent.java`; `model/MembershipLevel.java`, `MembershipLevel` cap in `Owner`.

OpenAPI schema field descriptions (load-bearing, from `openapi.yml`):
- `memberId` (2181-2194): `'<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'`, region from postcode.
- `householdId` (2206-2216): first 12 hex of SHA-256 over lastName|postcode.
- `identityKey` (2217-2229): 64-char SHA-256 over telephone|email|Soundex(lastName).
- `locality` (2265-2272): leading REGION of memberId; `UNKNOWN` fallback.
- `timezone` (2273-2282): IANA tz from region table; null for UNKNOWN.
- `ownerSegment` (2347-2360): enum `PREMIUM_METRO|PREMIUM_REGIONAL|STANDARD_METRO|STANDARD_REGIONAL`.

There is **no `apiVersion` and no `identity` wrapper** in this schema — everything is flat/top-level (v1).

---

## 4. Audit event schema/code

There is **no `schemaVersion`**. The audit event is emitted on owner create:

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — logs to a dedicated `AUDIT` logger: a formatted line (`id`, `memberId`, `registrationDate`, `membershipLevel`) plus a JSON `OwnerCreatedEvent`. Uses a process-wide `AtomicLong SEQUENCE`; identifier = `owner.getPrimaryIdentifier()` (= memberId).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`** — immutable `record OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, int ownerId, String memberId, int membershipLevel)`; `toJson()` renders `{"seq":…,"ownerId":…,"memberId":…,"membershipLevel":…,"event":"OWNER_CREATED"}`. Discriminator constant `EVENT = "OWNER_CREATED"`. **No `schemaVersion` field on the event.**

Test-side capture: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`** — attaches a Logback `ListAppender` to the `AUDIT` logger; `anyContains`, `anyAtLevel`, `count`, `messages`.

---

## 5. Existing `apiVersion` reference

- **Production code: none.** No `apiVersion` field on the DTO or anywhere in `src/main`.
- OpenAPI declares document `version: '1.0'` (`openapi.yml` line 8) — not a response `apiVersion`.
- The only `apiVersion` occurrence is in the target/acceptance test (see #6).
- There are `owner-v2`/`pets-v2` tags and OfficeFloor v2 route stubs under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/v2/owners.GET.yml` and `.../v2/pets.GET.yml`, plus openapi lines 15-23 describing "Version 2 endpoints". The many `openapi.yml` "An ID for this version of the response" hits refer to a per-response header `responseId`, not `apiVersion`.

---

## 6. Tests referencing these things

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`** — the v2 target contract (currently the only concrete `apiVersion` reference). Asserts on `GET /api/owners/{id}`:
```
$.apiVersion == 2
$.identity.memberId isNotEmpty
$.identity.identityKey isNotEmpty
$.identity.householdId isNotEmpty
$.memberId / $.identityKey / $.householdId  doesNotExist   (no longer top-level)
```
Header comment: "identity-v2: apiVersion is 2, the memberId/identityKey/householdId are grouped under a nested 'identity' object". This shape is **not yet implemented** in v1.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`** — black-box base. Pinned reference tables directly relevant: `CITY_REGION` (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), `REGION_TIMEZONE`, `REGION_POSTCODES` (same ranges as `AssignMemberId`), `region()`, `timezone()`, `validPostcode()`, `knownOwner()`; replicated `sha256hex`, `shaHex`, `luhn`, `toBusinessDay`. `structuredOwner()` (postcode 2000/NSW) is used by the v2 test.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`** — audit capture helper (above).

These three are the entire test tree (`src/test/java/.../acceptance/`).

---

## How tests are run

- **Build tool: Maven** (wrapper `./mvnw`; `pom.xml`; parent `spring-boot-starter-parent`). No Gradle.
- Test frameworks: JUnit 5 (`spring-boot-starter-test`) + MockMvc (`spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test`).
- Generated sources (incl. `OwnerDto`) are produced during build by the **openapi-generator-maven-plugin** (`pom.xml` lines 369-388) from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi` — so a clean build/generation must run before tests compile.
- Commands (from `readme.md`): `mvn clean install` (build incl. generation), `./mvnw spring-boot:run` to run the app. Standard test invocation: `./mvnw test` (unit) / `./mvnw verify`. To run just the acceptance test: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR),
            used to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this field is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (addressLine1, plus a single space and addressLine2 when
            addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when supplied; normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored and returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (unit, apartment
            etc.). Normalized the same way as addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's ageBand is derived from it, measured against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. The householdId is always computed deterministically from
            (lastName, postcode), so this flag no longer creates the household link. It only
            bypasses the household duplicate block: because owners sharing a lastName and postcode
            are the same household, a second such owner is rejected with 409 unless this flag is
            true, in which case it is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's canonical resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                from the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR who') when a title is supplied, or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678').
                Derived from the stored 'telephone', which stays raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year (starting 1 July) of the registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
                over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at registration; a
                collision with an existing member id is de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year carried by the owner's memberId, formatted 'FY<YY>' where
                YY is the memberId's FY segment. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is
                named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a July-December
                registrationDate reports the next calendar year's fiscal year
                (e.g. 2025-08-10 -> 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household, keyed on
                (lastName, postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized lastName, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every
                owner with the same lastName (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace) and
                postcode receives the same value automatically, regardless of creation order.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1c9d8b7e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 chars)
                over the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the Soundex of the lastName,
                joined by '|'. A create request is rejected with 409 when an existing (non-deleted)
                owner has the same identityKey, unless it declares 'sharesHousehold'. Because the
                telephone is part of the key, two owners with the same lastName and postcode but
                different telephones are not hard duplicates: the later one is created and flagged a
                possible (soft) duplicate.
              type: string
              example: '3b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email address
                is present; adds 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 elapsed fiscal year (1 July boundaries) since registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, bucketed from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the leading REGION component of the memberId,
                which is derived from the postcode. 'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Null when the
                region has no known timezone (including 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already held between
                40 and 49 owners (case-insensitive) — approaching the hard capacity limit of 50;
                otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it shared an existing owner's
                lastName (case-insensitive) and postcode while carrying a different telephone and
                was NOT a declared household member; otherwise false. A declared household member
                (created with 'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged. Assigned at registration
                and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of,
                i.e. the same lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Null when
                possibleDuplicate is false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored email:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the supplied birthDate measured against
                the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual risk review because any of the
                following hold: it is a possible (soft) duplicate (possibleDuplicate true);
                its stored email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known disposable
                provider's second-level label — e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain — without
                being one of the hard-blocked disposable domains); or its city is over its
                soft capacity (capacityWarning true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false.
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and retains the record, and the
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged
                deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

    PetFields:

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR),
            used to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this field is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (addressLine1, plus a single space and addressLine2 when
            addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when supplied; normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored and returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (unit, apartment
            etc.). Normalized the same way as addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's ageBand is derived from it, measured against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. The householdId is always computed deterministically from
            (lastName, postcode), so this flag no longer creates the household link. It only
            bypasses the household duplicate block: because owners sharing a lastName and postcode
            are the same household, a second such owner is rejected with 409 unless this flag is
            true, in which case it is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's canonical resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                from the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR who') when a title is supplied, or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678').
                Derived from the stored 'telephone', which stays raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response contract. Fixed at 2 for the version-2
                identity release, in which the memberId, identityKey and householdId are
                grouped under the nested 'identity' object.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year carried by the owner's memberId, formatted 'FY<YY>' where
                YY is the memberId's FY segment. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is
                named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a July-December
                registrationDate reports the next calendar year's fiscal year
                (e.g. 2025-08-10 -> 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household, keyed on
                (lastName, postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized lastName, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every
                owner with the same lastName (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace) and
                postcode receives the same value automatically, regardless of creation order.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1c9d8b7e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 chars)
                over the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the Soundex of the lastName,
                joined by '|'. A create request is rejected with 409 when an existing (non-deleted)
                owner has the same identityKey, unless it declares 'sharesHousehold'. Because the
                telephone is part of the key, two owners with the same lastName and postcode but
                different telephones are not hard duplicates: the later one is created and flagged a
                possible (soft) duplicate.
              type: string
              example: '3b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email address
                is present; adds 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 elapsed fiscal year (1 July boundaries) since registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, bucketed from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the leading REGION component of the memberId,
                which is derived from the postcode. 'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Null when the
                region has no known timezone (including 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already held between
                40 and 49 owners (case-insensitive) — approaching the hard capacity limit of 50;
                otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it shared an existing owner's
                lastName (case-insensitive) and postcode while carrying a different telephone and
                was NOT a declared household member; otherwise false. A declared household member
                (created with 'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged. Assigned at registration
                and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of,
                i.e. the same lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Null when
                possibleDuplicate is false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored email:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the supplied birthDate measured against
                the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'

input.old_string:

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
input.new_string:
OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the three identifiers grouped together. Each mixes in the
        fixed 'V2' version tag so no value produced under version 1 is ever produced again.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
            REGION is the version-2 region code — the fixed 'V2' version tag followed by
            the region derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN), e.g. 'V2NSW'; FY is the two-digit fiscal
            year (starting 1 July) of the registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8
            upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
            concatenated with the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
            over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at registration; a
            collision with an existing member id is de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW261A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household, keyed on
            (lastName, postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
            SHA-256 over the 'V2' version tag, the normalized lastName and the postcode, each
            '|'-separated, so every owner with the same lastName (case-insensitive, with collapsed
            whitespace) and postcode receives the same value automatically, regardless of creation
            order.
          type: string
          example: '3f2a1c9d8b7e'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 chars)
            over the 'V2' version tag, the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the
            Soundex of the lastName, joined by '|'. A create request is rejected with 409 when an
            existing (non-deleted) owner has the same identityKey, unless it declares
            'sharesHousehold'. Because the telephone is part of the key, two owners with the same
            lastName and postcode but different telephones are not hard duplicates: the later one
            is created and flagged a possible (soft) duplicate.
          type: string
          example: '3b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5f8a9c2e4067b1d5'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
